title: Crosscheck
lede: Receipts and invoices read by AI, then checked by plain code. Upload a batch and export clean rows. You only review what the checks flag.

number.label: of receipts read fully correct (CORD-v2 test and validation)

points: Flagged documents get one-click fixes on a review screen
Telegram and Gmail alerts through n8n; exports to CSV, Excel and QuickBooks
Ask about your documents in English or Bangla (25 of 26 test questions right)

title: BashaBook
lede: Shared accounts for Bangladeshi flats with a hired cook. It tracks every meal and every bazar or bill payment, then shows who owes whom at month end. A website and installable web app in English and Bangla.
points: Meals counted per person per day; tomorrow’s count locks at the cutoff, so the cook knows how many plates
At month end the app checks the cash count matches, then carries each balance forward
Push reminders for the meal lock, payments to confirm and the month-end close

media.alt: BashaBook home page with a month ledger

title: Legal Document AI
lede: Drafts internal case memos from uploaded legal documents, grounded in what the documents say.
points: Reads scanned PDFs and images with OCR
Each memo is built from the uploaded documents
Your corrections become rules for the next memo

title: AI social media automation
lede: A form starts the run: Llama 3.3 writes the post and a branded 1080×1080 image is composed. Nothing is published until a person approves it.
points: Copy and image in one run
Human approval before anything goes out
Publish step for Facebook and Instagram, tested on mock endpoints

title: Driver Distraction Detection
lede: A YOLOv10 model that watches the driver and flags distraction as it happens. Published at IEEE ICCIT 2025.
points: Spots 12 behaviours, from texting and phone calls to drinking and drowsiness
Works on photos and on video, frame by frame
Runs on ONNX Runtime, deployed with Docker through CI/CD
